name: CJMCU-1220 ADS1220 · installation reference
description: Selected purple CJMCU-1220 board. The seller identifies ADS1220 / code 102300-2 but supplies no dimensioned drawing. The adopted 22 × 21 mm PCB, 1.6 mm thickness, 0.6 mm corner radius and 5 × 5 × 1.2 mm illustrative chip are provisional; no mounting holes or pad locations are invented. Native Z0 is the assumed board underside. Loose headers and wires are excluded. Measure the delivered board, component height and soldered harness before fabrication. This is an installation reference, not verified supplier CAD, a pinout or a complete electrical design.
